topic: Asking for a Different Size in Fitting

script.title: A DIFFERENT SIZE, PLEASE
script.scene_zh: 試衣間外 · 請求換號
script.story_hook: The jeans fit perfectly, except everywhere.
script.intro_zh: 牛仔褲「很合」，除了每個地方都緊。
script.welcome_en: Hi again, great to have you! Today we swap jeans sizes at the fitting room.
script.welcome_zh: 又見面啦，太好了！今天在試衣間換牛仔褲尺寸。
script.outro: Perfect fit, perfect English. Catch you next time!
script.outro_zh: 尺寸合了，英文也順了！下次再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's echo every line together, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起一句一句跟讀，慢慢來。

Join Zoe as she asks for another size, gets the associate to hold a pair, and rescues a stuck zipper — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus line-by-line repeat practice in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】👖試穿換號英文｜詢問尺寸・請員留貨・拉鍊救援｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
牛仔褲卡在腰間，想要的尺寸卻賣光了？
「幫我留著」這句話用英文要怎麼講？

這一集帶大家走進服飾店的試衣間，Zoe 拿著一條偏小的窄版牛仔褲，從詢問尺寸、請店員留貨，到拉鍊卡住的緊急小插曲，全程都是自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
👖 反映尺寸問題：例如「these jeans run really small」、「the waist is a battle」。
🧷 詢問與留貨：例如「how about dark blue, size fourteen?」、「could you hold it while I try?」。
🤐 突發與收尾：例如「the zipper feels stuck」、「I'll meet you at the register」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次試穿太緊，別硬擠，勇敢舉手請店員幫忙！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a pair of jeans outside the fitting room

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, these jeans run really small, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðiːz dʒiːnz rʌn ˈrɪəli smɔːl ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這條牛仔褲偏小得誇張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens! What size did you grab?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz wʌt saɪz dɪd ju ɡræb/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A twelve, but the waist is a battle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə twɛlv bʌt ðə weɪst ɪz ə ˈbætl/
dialogue.zh: 十二號，但腰頭像在戰鬥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... oh, they're all gone, hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk oʊ ðɪr ɔːl ɡɑːn hʌm/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你查……噢，全賣光了，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the skinny cut runs tiny. Try relaxed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈskɪni kʌt rʌnz ˈtaɪni traɪ rɪˈlækst/
dialogue.zh: 窄版版型特別偏小，試試寬鬆款？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd love to. Is a thirteen possible there?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd lʌv tu ɪz ə ˌθɜːrˈtiːn ˈpɑːsəbl ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我很想試。那邊會有十三號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One moment... how about dark blue, size fourteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmoʊmənt haʊ əˈbaʊt dɑːrk bluː saɪz ˌfɔːrˈtiːn/
dialogue.zh: 稍等……深藍色十四號怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark blue? Does it look close to black?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑːrk bluː dʌz ɪt lʊk kloʊs tʊ blæk/
dialogue.zh: 深藍？看起來接近黑色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty much. Same fit, the tag shows it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪti mʌtʃ seɪm fɪt ðə tæɡ ʃoʊz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，吊牌寫著同款版型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Could you hold it while I try?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kʊd ju hoʊld ɪt waɪl aɪ traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，試穿前可以幫我留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the last fitting room is open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə læst ˈfɪtɪŋ ruːm ɪz ˈoʊpən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，最後一間試衣間空著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed... um, the zipper feels stuck?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪŋɡərz krɔːst ʌm ðə ˈzɪpər fiːlz stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 希望順利……呃，拉鍊好像卡住了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh dear. Want me to grab another pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ dɪr wɑːnt mi tʊ ɡræb əˈnʌðər pɛr/
dialogue.zh: 噢，天啊。要不要我再拿一條？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, no — it just needs one good tug.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ noʊ ɪt dʒʌst niːdz wʌn ɡʊd tʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，它只需要用力一拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Famous last words, fitting rooms, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈfeɪməs læst wɜːrdz ˈfɪtɪŋ ruːmz ˈtrʊli/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，試衣間的最後一句話總應驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fits! I'll take these, zipper and all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts aɪl teɪk ðiːz ˈzɪpər ənd ɔːl/
dialogue.zh: 合身！這些我買了，拉鍊也算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! I'll meet you at the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪl miːt ju ət ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我在收銀台那裡等你。
